summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for a clotted and infected right thigh arteriovenous graft with purulent drainage from a pustule. He reported localized pain for about a week but denied fever or chills. He was started on Unasyn for suspected graft infection, and blood and wound cultures were obtained, all of which showed no growth. After hemodialysis, he underwent surgical removal of the graft due to purulent drainage. He remained afebrile postoperatively with stable labs and a therapeutic vancomycin level. Given his homelessness, he was discharged to an extended care facility for ongoing wound care and IV antibiotic administration. He will continue vancomycin indefinitely post-dialysis, receive bid dressing changes, and follow up with surgery in one week. His seizure medications were adjusted to ensure dosing after dialysis, and his heart failure and other chronic conditions remained stable.
